made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/caja-sheet-make.js, from caja-set.html (window.CAJA.CD) and the design of La caja. A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX, OY = H / 2 + originY. A box is the screen bounding box of its 8 projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 1: the counter top; z .96: the sill) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty: the lowest drawn row is 54), a child 41 rows (a 44-row canvas); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (so row 25 of the canvas is on sy, as juego.js frogBox: his shadow line q.y + 25); a small thing: its bottom middle on the point
rules.view: a view has a zoom (here 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture) and x0, kept inside 0 .. 44. Never a fraction
rules.person: for the check "seen from the thighs up": a person is 53 rows tall (the standing figure's drawn rows), at least 28 of them above the counter's top back edge at his column
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.cards: tecla_a and tecla_b have a screen box (x, y, w, h) in picture pixels and no world point: the game draws them over the picture

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3), so the counter hides don Pepe's legs, nothing behind him hides him, and the wall hides the three children outside the shop window below the sill.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The upright plane through the feet, as El balcón's front; the same test for people and for things on the counter
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the floor (z 0)
